0:
cp /config/cookies.txt /config/cookies-rw.txt
ytdl-sub --log-level=debug --config=/config/config.yaml sub /media/youtube/subscriptions.yaml
echo "[cronjob:command] Fixing permissions, started at $$(date --rfc-2822)"
find $${MEDIA_FOLDER} -user root -exec chown 568:568 "{}" \; -exec chmod 777 "{}" \;
echo "[cronjob:command] Fixed permissions, ended at $$(date --rfc-2822)"

mariadb-dump -h go-discord-archiver-db --password="$(MARIADB_PROD_ROOT_PASSWORD)" go_archiver > /backup/dump.sql && \
while [[ $(mariadb -uroot --password="$${MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD}" "$${MARIADB_DATABASE}" < /backup/dump.sql; echo $?) != 0 ]]; do
  sleep 1
done &
exec docker-entrypoint.sh mariadbd

ops=(
  "db:add-missing-primary-keys"
  "db:add-missing-indices"
  "db:add-missing-columns"
  "files:cleanup"
)
grey="\e[1;30m"
reset="\e[0m"
green="\e[1;32m"
red="\e[1;31m"
for op in "$${ops[@]}" ; do
  echo -e "$${grey}Running php occ $op $reset"
  su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ $op && echo -en "$green" || echo -en "$red"
  echo -e "Finished php occ $op $reset"
done &&
echo -e "$${grey}Running php occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive $reset"
su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive && echo -en "$green" || echo -en "$red"
echo -e "Finished php occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive $reset"
while :; do /cron.sh; done

chmod +x /var/www/html/custom_apps/notify_push/bin/x86_64/notify_push && \
while :; do su www-data \
  -s /var/www/html/custom_apps/notify_push/bin/x86_64/notify_push -- \
  /var/www/html/config/config.php; sleep 1; done &
pid=$!
grey="\e[1;30m"
reset="\e[0m"
green="\e[1;32m"
red="\e[1;31m"
echo -e "$${grey}Waiting a few seconds for services to start$${reset}"
sleep 10
echo -e "$${grey}Testing if push app is configured"
op="notify_push:setup https://${social_domain}/push"
while ! su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ "notify_push:self-test"; do
  echo -e "$${grey}Self-test failed, running php occ $op $reset"
  if ! su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ $op; then
    echo -e "$${red}$${op} operation failed, retrying...$${reset}"
    sleep 5
  fi
done
echo -e "$${green}Test passed$${reset}"
wait $pid

mkdir -p /home/nonroot/.claude
[ -f /home/nonroot/.claude/settings.json ] || cp /home/nonroot/config/claude-settings.json /home/nonroot/.claude/settings.json
[ -f /home/nonroot/.claude/CLAUDE.md ] || cp /home/nonroot/config/CLAUDE.md /home/nonroot/.claude/CLAUDE.md
echo claude mcp remove -s user victoriametrics 2>/dev/null
echo claude mcp remove-s user  chrome-devtools 2>/dev/null
echo claude mcp add -s user --transport http victoriametrics http://mcp-victoriametrics.victoria-metrics.svc.cluster.local:8080/mcp
echo claude mcp add -s user --transport http chrome-devtools http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp

[[runners]]
  [runners.kubernetes]
    helper_image = "ghcr.io/vaskozl/gitlab-runner-helper:latest"
    cpu_request = "500m"
    cpu_limit = "1"
    memory_request = "256Mi"
    memory_limit = "8Gi"
    service_cpu_request = "100m"
    service_cpu_limit = "1"
    service_memory_request = "50Mi"
    service_memory_limit = "1Gi"
    helper_cpu_request = "5m"
    helper_cpu_limit = "500m"
    helper_memory_request = "50Mi"
    helper_memory_limit = "200Mi"
    # Used by bubblewrap
    cap_add = ["NET_ADMIN", "SYS_ADMIN"]
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.empty_dir]]
      name = "docker-emptydir"
      mount_path = "/var/run"
      medium = "Memory"
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.pvc]]
      name = "apk-repo-pvc"
      mount_path = "/apks"
    [runners.kubernetes.node_selector]
      "kubernetes.io/arch" = "amd64"
